examples.chinese: 她很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn piàoliàng.
examples.english: She is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 新同學很可愛。
examples.pinyin: Xīn tóngxué hěn kěài.
examples.english: The new classmate is lovely.

examples.chinese: 她很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn piàoliàng.
examples.english: She is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 她是新同學，叫友美。她很可愛。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì xīn tóngxué, jiào Yǒuměi. Tā hěn kěài.
examples.english: She is our new classmate. Her name is Youmei. She is cute.

examples.chinese: A：你好嗎？ B：我很好。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ hǎo ma? B: Wǒ hěn hǎo.
examples.english: A: How are you? B: I am good.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡做飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zuòfàn.
examples.english: I like cooking very much.

examples.chinese: 中明今天很累。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngmíng jīntiān hěn lèi.
examples.english: Zhongming is very tired today.

examples.chinese: 他很喜歡看書。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān kànshū.
examples.english: He likes reading books very much.

examples.chinese: A：這種蛋糕很貴嗎？ B：是啊，這種蛋糕不便宜。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhè zhǒng dàngāo hěn guì ma? B: Shì ā, zhè zhǒng dàngāo bù piányí.
examples.english: A: Is this kind of cake expensive? B: Yes, this kind of cake is not cheap.

examples.chinese: 紅色的花、白色的花都很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Hóngsè de huā, báisè de huā, dōu hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: Red and white flowers are both beautiful.

examples.chinese: 這朵花很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duǒ huā hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: This flower is beautiful.

examples.chinese: 那個學生很好看。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge xuéshēng hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The student is very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The color of this clothing is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 他今天很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: He is very happy today.

examples.chinese: 我很忙，也很累。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, yě hěn lèi.
examples.english: I’m very busy and tired as well.

examples.chinese: 現在我不渴，我很餓。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ bù kě, wǒ hěn è.
examples.english: I am not thirsty now, I am really hungry.

examples.chinese: 我的中文書很多，你要不要看？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén shū hěn duō, nǐ yào bú yào kàn?
examples.english: I have many Chinese books, would you like to read?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的甜點很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiándiǎn hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant has delicious desserts.

examples.chinese: 這種飲料很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: This kind of beverage tastes good.

examples.chinese: 你很渴嗎？我有一瓶飲料，你要不要喝？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn kě ma? Wǒ yǒu yì píng yǐnliào, nǐ yào bú yào hē?
examples.english: Are you thirsty? I have a bottle of beverage, would you like to have some?

examples.chinese: 我的女朋友很喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ péngyǒu hěn xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: My girlfriend likes bubble milk tea very much.

examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的天氣很熱，很多人都喜歡喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de tiānqì hěn rè, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuān hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: During summer the weather is very hot in Taiwan, many people like to have beverages.

examples.chinese: 這家商店的東西很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de dōngxi hěn piányi.
examples.english: Stuff in this store is quite cheap.

examples.chinese: 這本書很不錯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn búcuò.
examples.english: This book is not bad.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡這家店的巧克力蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn de qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
examples.english: I like the chocolate cake from this shop.

examples.chinese: 這棟房子不大，可是很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi bú dà, kěshì hěn guì.
examples.english: This is not a big house, but very expensive.

examples.chinese: 我家的廚房很大，我常常在家做飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de chúfáng hěn dà, wǒ chángcháng zài jiā zuòfàn.
examples.english: My kitchen is quite big, I often cook at home.

examples.chinese: 這個新房子沒有很多家具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīn fángzi méiyǒu hěn duō jiājù.
examples.english: There is not much furniture in this new house.

examples.chinese: 窗戶前面有很多花，很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Chuānghù qiánmiàn yǒu hěn duō huā, hěn piàoliàng.
examples.english: There are many flowers in front of the window. It’s very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

examples.chinese: 今天我去朋友家玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qù péngyǒu jiā wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: I had fun at my friend’s place today.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹跑得很慢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei pǎo de hěn màn.
examples.english: My younger sister runs very slowly.

examples.chinese: 她看書看得很快。
examples.pinyin: Tā kànshū kàn de hěn kuài.
examples.english: She reads very fast.

examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.chinese: 王老師的課很有趣，每個學生都喜歡她。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de kè hěn yǒuqù, měi ge xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: Teacher Wang’s class is very interesting; every student likes her.

examples.chinese: 我覺得這部電影很有趣，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: I think this movie is very interesting. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

examples.chinese: 我很累，想在房間休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, xiǎng zài fángjiān xiūxí.
examples.english: I am tired; I want to take a rest in the room.

examples.chinese: 她很喜歡花，你可以送她一些漂亮的花。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān huā, nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā yìxiē piàoliàng de huā.
examples.english: She likes flowers very much. You can give her some beautiful flowers.

examples.chinese: 他唱歌唱得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā chànggē chàng de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: He enjoys singing very much.

examples.chinese: 他會唱很多首中文歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì chàng hěn duō shǒu Zhōngwén gē.
examples.english: He can sing a lot of Chinese songs.

examples.chinese: 他的舞跳得很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He dances very well.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很喜歡畫畫，他畫得很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn xǐhuān huàhuà, tā huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That child likes painting and he draws very well.

examples.chinese: 這張畫很好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng huà hěn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: This painting is brilliant. I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 老師說要送我們書，我們都很高興。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō yào sòng wǒmen shū, wǒmen dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.english: The teacher said she/he is going to give us some books as gifts; we are all very happy.

examples.chinese: 很可愛，友美喜歡可愛的東西。
examples.pinyin: Hěn kěài. Yǒuměi xǐhuān kěài de dōngxi.
examples.english: It’s very cute. Youmei likes cute stuff.

examples.chinese: 五十塊錢很便宜！妳看，哪個顏色漂亮？
examples.pinyin: Wǔshí kuài qián hěn piányí! Nǐ kàn, nǎ ge yánsè piàoliang?
examples.english: It is inexpensive! Look, which color is better?

examples.chinese: 咖啡、茶，我都喜歡。我也很餓，想吃一點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Kāfēi, chá, wǒ dōu xǐhuān. Wǒ yě hěn è, xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: Coffee and tea, I like them both. I am also hungry; I would like to have some food.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 他們賣很多種飲料。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen mài hěn duō zhǒng yǐnliào.
examples.english: They have various kinds of drink.

examples.chinese: 我知道一家很不錯的咖啡廳，那裡的冰淇淋很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yì jiā hěn búcuò de kāfēitīng, nàlǐ de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: I know a nice café. They serve delicious ice cream.

examples.chinese: 有啊！他們有很多種冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu a! Tāmen yǒu hěn duō zhǒng bīngqílín.
examples.english: Oh, yeah. They have lots of kinds of ice cream.

examples.chinese: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
examples.english: I am very busy and I am going to the kitchen to cook now. You go check your room again.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，海邊的風景也很漂亮，我想去游泳，妳們想去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, hǎibiān de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliàng, wǒ xiǎng qù yóuyǒng, nǐmen xiǎng qù ma?
examples.english: The weather is pretty good today, so is the view at the beach. I want to go swimming. Do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 我不喜歡跑步，我跑步跑得很慢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān pǎobù, wǒ pǎobù pǎo de hěn màn.
examples.english: I do not like to run; I run slowly.

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 機場附近的風景也很漂亮，我常常去看風景、看飛機。
examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng fùjìn de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliang, wǒ chángcháng qù kàn fēngjǐng, kàn fēijī.
examples.english: The scenery near the airport is beautiful; I often go there to see the view and watch the planes.

examples.chinese: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 我很想去看，可是我最近胖了五公斤，我怕衣服不好買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn, kěshì wǒ zuìjìn pàng le wǔ gōngjīn, wǒ pà yīfu bù hǎo mǎi.
examples.english: I would like to check it out. But I have recently gained 5 kilograms, so I am worried that they don’t have my size.

examples.chinese: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，你們要戴口罩，也要常常洗手。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, nǐmen yào dài kǒuzhào, yě yào chángcháng xǐshǒu.
examples.english: Many people got sick lately. You need to wear a surgical mask and wash your hands often.

examples.chinese: 老師，我很健康，不常生病。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: I am healthy and seldom get sick, teacher.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣冷了，很多人感冒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì lěng le, hěn duō rén gǎnmào le.
examples.english: The weather is getting cold recently, many people got colds.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 最近也有很多人肚子痛。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn yě yǒu hěn duō rén dùzi tòng.
examples.english: Many people have a stomachache as well.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

examples.chinese: 很簡單，上網一查就知道了。
examples.pinyin: Hěn jiǎndān, shàngwǎng yì chá jiù zhīdào le.
examples.english: It’s very simple. You can know it as soon as you check it online.

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

examples.chinese: 我的女朋友很喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。

examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的天氣很熱，很多人都喜歡喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de tiānqì hěn rè, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuān hē yǐnliào.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。

examples.chinese: 天氣好熱，我們去喝飲料，好不好？

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？

examples.english: Okay! What would you like to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 你幾點去學校？

examples.english: What time do you go to school?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn shí fēn qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: I go to school at 8:10.

examples.chinese: 今天是星期一，你不去學校嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí yī, nǐ bú qù xuéxiào ma?
examples.english: It is Monday today; aren’t you going to school?

examples.chinese: 他今天不來學校嗎？

examples.english: Isn’t he coming to school today?

examples.chinese: 他在學校，不在家。

examples.english: He is at school, not at home.

examples.chinese: 我在學校，你要來這裡嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxiào, nǐ yào lái zhèlǐ ma?
examples.english: I am at the school. Do you want to come here? (Are you coming?)

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

examples.chinese: 我每個星期都去學校跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu qù xuéxiào pǎobù.
examples.english: I go to school to run every week.

examples.chinese: 我們學校旁邊有一家電影院。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā diànyǐngyuàn.
examples.english: There is a movie theater next to our school.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 這些是中文書，那些是英文書。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì Zhōngwén shū, nàxiē shì Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: These are books in Chinese; those are in English.

examples.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共兩萬三千五百零五塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng liǎng wàn sān qiān wǔ bǎi líng wǔ kuài.

examples.english: But I will be doing language exchange during that time. I can’t make it.

examples.english: My younger sister runs very slowly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān pǎobù, wǒ pǎobù pǎo de hěn màn.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"在這家餐廳吃飯，只要滿兩千塊，就送一盤水果。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"那個杯子裡裝滿了水。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, zhǐyào mǎn liǎngqiān kuài, jiù sòng yī pán shuǐguǒ. Nàge bēizi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ.
examples.english: At this restaurant, as long as you reach 2,000 dollars, they give you a plate of fruit. That cup is full of water.

examples.chinese: 你說你昨天吃了五盤芒果冰，太誇張了吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō nǐ zuótiān chīle wǔ pán mángguǒ bīng, tài kuāzhāng le ba!
examples.english: You say you ate five plates of mango shaved ice yesterday—that's too exaggerated!

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
中國人看傳統戲劇時都喜歡準備一盤瓜子，邊吃邊欣賞。
這一盤棋你下得真好，你一定花了很多工夫研究。
這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
那家公司的鍵盤常出問題，我再傻也不會跟他們購買。
我們到小張家時，他端了一盤切好的水果來招待我們。

examples.chinese: 他習慣睡覺以前聽一點兒音樂。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn shuìjiào yǐqián tīng yīdiǎnr yīnyuè.
examples.english: He is used to listening to a little music before sleeping.

examples.chinese: 張先生不但飲食習慣很好，而且每天運動，所以身體很健康。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng bùdàn yǐnshí xíguàn hěn hǎo, érqiě měitiān yùndòng, suǒyǐ shēntǐ hěn jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang not only has very good eating habits, but also exercises every day, so he is very healthy.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己特殊的風俗習慣，有時候外國人不容易了解。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ tèshū de fēngsú xíguàn, yǒu shíhou wàiguó rén bù róngyì liǎojiě.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own special customs and habits, which sometimes foreigners find hard to understand.

examples.chinese: 我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.
examples.english: My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately.

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。

examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.english: This intersection is very dangerous; car accidents often happen here.

examples.english: That online store often sells fake goods; you'd better not be tricked.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。

examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.pinyin: Dā gōngchē shí, niánqīngrén yīnggāi bǎ wèizi gěi lǎorén zuò, zhè shì yì zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: When taking the bus, young people should give their seats to the elderly; this is a kind of politeness.

examples.chinese: 別在房子裡燒東西，要不然可能會把房子也燒了。
examples.pinyin: Bié zài fángzi lǐ shāo dōngxi, yàobùrán kěnéng huì bǎ fángzi yě shāo le.
examples.english: Don't burn things inside the house, otherwise you might burn the house down too.

examples.chinese: 我很餓，同事把他的薯條分一半給我，讓我好感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn è, tóngshì bǎ tā de shǔtiáo fēn yí bàn gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
examples.english: I was very hungry, and my colleague shared half of his fries with me, which really moved me.

examples.chinese: 下課鐘還沒響，可是學生都把背包拿起來準備回家了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè zhōng hái méi xiǎng, kěshì xuéshēng dōu bǎ bēibāo ná qǐlái zhǔnbèi huí jiā le.
examples.english: The class-ending bell has not rung yet, but the students have all picked up their backpacks and are getting ready to go home.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yīqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwùshè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yīqǐ, dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.chinese: 媽媽說要把房間打掃得乾乾淨淨的，這樣才能開開心心地過年。
examples.pinyin: Māma shuō yào bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng de, zhèyàng cái néng kāikāixīnxīn de guònián.
examples.english: Mom said to clean the room spotlessly clean, so that we can celebrate the New Year happily.

examples.chinese: 媽媽說要把房間打掃得乾乾淨淨的，這樣才能開開心心地過年。
examples.pinyin: Māma shuō yào bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng de, zhèyàng cái néng kāikāixīnxīn de guònián.
examples.english: Mom said to clean the room spotlessly clean, so that we can celebrate the New Year happily.

examples.chinese: 我把這篇作文修改好了，明天就可以交給老師了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè piān zuòwén xiūgǎi hǎo le, míngtiān jiù kěyǐ jiāo gěi lǎoshī le.
examples.english: I have revised this essay, so I can hand it to the teacher tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 這個週末以前，超過三千塊錢的東西都可以打九折，請把握機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò yǐqián, chāoguò sānqiān kuài qián de dōngxi dōu kěyǐ dǎ jiǔzhé, qǐng bǎwò jīhuì.
examples.english: Before this weekend, anything over 3,000 dollars is 10% off—please seize the opportunity.

examples.chinese: 你得把保證書帶來，我們才能幫你免費修理電腦。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi bǎ bǎozhèngshū dàilái, wǒmen cái néng bāng nǐ miǎnfèi xiūlǐ diànnǎo.
examples.english: You have to bring the warranty, and only then can we help you repair the computer for free.

examples.chinese: 我覺得把錢存在銀行比放在家裡安全多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bǎ qián cún zài yínháng bǐ fàng zài jiā lǐ ānquán duō le.
examples.english: I think saving money in the bank is much safer than keeping it at home.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我把剛買回來的小說擺在書架上。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"準備吃飯了，快點兒把碗筷擺好！","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ gāng mǎi huílái de xiǎoshuō bǎi zài shūjià shàng. Zhǔnbèi chīfàn le, kuài diǎnr bǎ wǎnkuài bǎi hǎo!
examples.english: I placed the novel I just bought on the bookshelf. We're getting ready to eat; quickly set out the bowls and chopsticks!

examples.chinese: 我去義大利旅行的時候，不小心把護照弄丟了，我擔心死了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yìdàlì lǚxíng de shíhou, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ hùzhào nòngdiū le, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
examples.english: When I was traveling in Italy, I accidentally lost my passport; I was worried to death.

examples.chinese: 我覺得「把」的語法很難，造句的時候常弄錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde “bǎ” de yǔfǎ hěn nán, zàojù de shíhou cháng nòngcuò.
examples.english: I think the grammar of “bǎ” is very difficult; when making sentences, I often get it wrong.

examples.chinese: 老師把這個生字清楚地寫在黑板上。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zhège shēngzì qīngchǔ de xiě zài hēibǎn shàng.
examples.english: The teacher clearly wrote this new vocabulary word on the blackboard.

examples.chinese: 現在開始上課，請大家把書翻到第九課。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài kāishǐ shàngkè, qǐng dàjiā bǎ shū fān dào dì jiǔ kè.
examples.english: Class starts now; everyone, please turn your books to Lesson 9.

examples.chinese: 把考試的日期記在手機裡，這樣做就不會忘了。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ kǎoshì de rìqī jì zài shǒujī lǐ, zhèyàng zuò jiù bù huì wàng le.
examples.english: Record the exam date in your phone; doing it this way, you won't forget.

examples.chinese: 請不要把貼紙貼在教室的桌子上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bùyào bǎ tiēzhǐ tiē zài jiàoshì de zhuōzi shàng.
examples.english: Please don't stick stickers on the classroom desks.

examples.chinese: 我把搭車的日期、時間都記下來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dā chē de rìqī, shíjiān dōu jì xiàlái le.
examples.english: I have written down the date and time of the train ride.

examples.chinese: 他是一個很負責的老師，每天都把學生寫的功課看完。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge hěn fùzé de lǎoshī, měi tiān dōu bǎ xuéshēng xiě de gōngkè kàn wán.
examples.english: He is a very responsible teacher; every day he finishes reading the homework the students write.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我父母這個週末都不在家，家裡只剩下我一個人。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"我已經把衣服洗完了，剩下的家事請你做。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ zhège zhōumò dōu bù zài jiā, jiālǐ zhǐ shèngxià wǒ yī ge rén. Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ yīfu xǐ wán le, shèngxià de jiāshì qǐng nǐ zuò.
examples.english: My parents are both not at home this weekend; only I am left at home. I have already finished washing the clothes; please do the remaining housework.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"媽媽不在，晚飯我得自己弄。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"弟弟把房間弄得又髒又亂，誰也不想進去。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Māma bù zài, wǎnfàn wǒ děi zìjǐ nòng. Dìdi bǎ fángjiān nòng de yòu zāng yòu luàn, shéi yě bù xiǎng jìnqù.
examples.english: Mom isn't home, so I have to make dinner myself. My little brother made the room both dirty and messy; no one wants to go in.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"付了房租以後，你這個月的獎學金還剩多少？","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"弟弟把菜都吃完了，什麼都沒剩。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Fù le fángzū yǐhòu, nǐ zhège yuè de jiǎngxuéjīn hái shèng duōshǎo? Dìdi bǎ cài dōu chī wán le, shénme dōu méi shèng.
examples.english: After paying the rent, how much of this month's scholarship do you still have left? My little brother ate all the food; nothing is left.

examples.chinese: 請把洗衣機放在這邊，冰箱放在那邊。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xǐyījī fàng zài zhèbiān, bīngxiāng fàng zài nàbiān.
examples.english: Please put the washing machine here and the refrigerator there.

examples.chinese: 他把全部的碗筷都擦乾了，可以給客人用了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ quánbù de wǎnkuài dōu cā gān le, kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng le.
examples.english: He wiped all the bowls and chopsticks dry; they can be used for the guests now.

examples.chinese: 你要把這些小說都丟了？太可惜了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào bǎ zhèxiē xiǎoshuō dōu diū le? Tài kěxī le!
examples.english: You're going to throw away all these novels? What a pity!

examples.chinese: 我爸爸本來在車站旁邊有一塊地，後來他把那塊地賣了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba běnlái zài chēzhàn pángbiān yǒu yī kuài dì, hòulái tā bǎ nà kuài dì mài le.
examples.english: My dad originally had a piece of land next to the station, but later he sold that piece of land.

examples.chinese: 弟弟的手很髒，我叫他先把手洗一洗，再吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi de shǒu hěn zāng, wǒ jiào tā xiān bǎ shǒu xǐ yī xǐ, zài chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: My younger brother's hands are very dirty; I asked him to wash his hands first before eating dinner.

examples.chinese: 來台灣學中文以前，我把一些舊書丟了。聽說你的車子丟了。是在哪裡丟的？
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén yǐqián, wǒ bǎ yīxiē jiù shū diū le. Tīngshuō nǐ de chēzi diū le. Shì zài nǎlǐ diū de?
examples.english: Before coming to Taiwan to study Chinese, I threw away some old books. I heard your car was lost. Where was it lost?

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
examples.pinyin: Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!
examples.english: Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.
examples.english: Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 王小姐失戀後，花了三年時間才把那個男的忘掉。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě shīliàn hòu, huā le sān nián shíjiān cái bǎ nàge nán de wàngdiào.
examples.english: After Ms. Wang was crossed in love, it took her three years to forget that man.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 五年前經驗過護照被偷的意外後，每次出國我都把護照放在上衣裡面的口袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ nián qián jīngyàn guò hùzhào bèi tōu de yìwài hòu, měi cì chūguó wǒ dōu bǎ hùzhào fàng zài shàngyī lǐmiàn de kǒudài.
examples.english: After experiencing the accident of having my passport stolen five years ago, every time I go abroad, I put my passport in the pocket inside my jacket.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 我們把考卷交給老師後，老師就把正確的答案告訴大家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ kǎojuàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī hòu, lǎoshī jiù bǎ zhèngquè de dá'àn gàosu dàjiā.
examples.english: After we handed the exam papers to the teacher, the teacher then told everyone the correct answers.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了。今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ fàng zài yuànzi lǐ de yī duī kōng píngzi, kōng guànzi dōu rēng le. Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yī piān zuòwén, kěshì wǒ de nǎozi kōngkōng de, yī gè zì yě xiě bù chūlái.
examples.english: Mom threw away all the empty bottles and empty cans that were placed in the yard. Today's homework is to write a composition, but my mind is completely empty; I can't write a single word.

examples.chinese: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.
examples.english: Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 他把存了半輩子的錢都拿去做生意，結果生意不成功，錢都沒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ cún le bànbèizi de qián dōu ná qù zuò shēngyì, jiéguǒ shēngyì bù chénggōng, qián dōu méi le.
examples.english: He took all the money he had saved for half his life to do business, but the business was unsuccessful, and all the money was gone.

examples.chinese: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.
examples.english: After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

examples.chinese: 每年農曆一月初一是華人新年的第一天。我父母每個月初寄錢給我，但我總是在月中就把錢花光了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Měi nián nónglì yī yuè chū yī shì Huárén xīnnián de dì yī tiān. 2. Wǒ fùmǔ měi ge yuè chū jì qián gěi wǒ, dàn wǒ zǒngshì zài yuè zhōng jiù bǎ qián huā guāng le.
examples.english: 1. The first day of the first lunar month each year is the first day of the Chinese New Year. 2. My parents send me money at the beginning of every month, but I always spend it all by the middle of the month.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yìshēng zhǐyǒu duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yīnggāi bǎwò shíjiān, ràng shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, kuàilè.
examples.english: A person's whole life is only a short few decades; one should grasp time and make life fulfilling and happy.

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

examples.chinese: 看電影時，如果要暫時離開座位，記得把重要物品帶在身上。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng shí, rúguǒ yào zhànshí líkāi zuòwèi, jìde bǎ zhòngyào wùpǐn dài zài shēnshang.
examples.english: When watching a movie, if you need to temporarily leave your seat, remember to carry your important belongings with you.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english: I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
要是你有看電視的空，就幫我把髒衣服放到洗衣機裡吧。
小王做事非常粗心，因此公司一直不敢把重要的業務交給他。
剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？
我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
機會來了就應該好好把握，不然就太可惜了。
我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。
媽媽常一邊看做菜節目，一邊把作法抄下來。
你別把剛領的鈔票放在口袋裡，很容易不見的。
他剛去超市買了一把刷子，想趁週末時好好把浴室刷乾淨。
想申請獎學金的話，得先影印你的證件，再把影本寄給學校。
他把這塊長方形蛋糕分成兩塊三角形的。
室友A:嘿，吃完飯後不能把碗筷擺在桌子讓別人洗喔。室友B:不好意思，我這就去洗。室友A:嘿，你還真聽話(obedient)啊。
註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
他愛亂花錢，三天下來，就把一個月的生活費花光了。
購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
你把廣告設計得那麼小，這樣的宣傳怎麼有效果呢？
警察亮出證件，叫那個正在吸毒的人乖乖把毒品交出來。
一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
A:你快點把衣服換好。還不出門，就趕不上飛機嘍？ B:好啦，我知道了。
食品罐頭吃完以後把罐子洗乾淨，就可以回收了。
他把我的手機壓壞了，我要他買一支賠我。
奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
想把菜園照顧好，平時就得多用心，看到蟲子就得處理。
我把房間裡那條黑色繩子看成蛇，嚇了我一大跳。
這些帶子是我小學的記錄，我請朋友把它存進電腦裡。
練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
請你把空罐子放在袋子裡，好讓垃圾車一起回收。
吃飯的時候把筷子插在碗裡，會被臺灣人認為沒有規矩。
有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
我明天要把這份作業交給老師，遲了老師就不收了。
小王追求祝小姐好幾年了，不過祝小姐一直只把她當好友。
自殺或許能令個人不再受到痛苦，但卻把痛苦留給了身邊的人。
露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
他做運動時手甩得太用力，把手錶都甩得飛出去了。
你既然把工廠交給他，就得放手讓他去管理。
現在去醫院拿藥，藥袋上都會把藥方及使用方式寫得很清楚。
奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。
開車時千萬別把頭探出車窗外，以免發生危險。
王媽媽一直把媳婦當作自己的女兒，當他們家的媳婦真幸福。
李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
鵝一看到陌生人就會大叫，所以鄉村裡有人把鵝當成狗來看家(kānjiā， to guard the house)。
我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。
你去書房把地板拖乾淨，好放我新買的地毯。
我想在床旁邊擺個書桌，不過空間不太夠，你可以幫我把床移到牆邊嗎？
祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
爸爸為了迎接伯父回臺灣過節，把客房打掃得很乾淨。
他把朋友送他的畫先捲起來，等有空時再找地方掛上。
小孩子剛學習用筷子吃麵條時，常需要媽媽先替他把麵拌一拌。
明天一大早要動身出國旅遊，所以我在睡前先把鬧鐘調好。

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 父母是我最親愛的家人，誰都不能代替他們在我心中的地位。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì wǒ zuì qīn'ài de jiārén, shéi dōu bù néng dàitì tāmen zài wǒ xīnzhōng de dìwèi.
examples.english: My parents are my dearest family members; no one can replace their place in my heart.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 要是你不能喝酒，跟客戶乾杯時可以用茶代替酒。

items.wordHook: Combining 代(era) and 替(change): 代替 means replace.

examples.chinese: 按照華人的習俗，紅包裡面的錢不可以是四百、四千等等。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Huárén de xísú, hóngbāo lǐmiàn de qián bù kěyǐ shì sìbǎi, sìqiān děngděng.
examples.english: According to Chinese customs, the money inside a red envelope cannot be 400, 4000, etc.

examples.chinese: 按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
按照我國官方規定，民間辦理環保活動可向官方申請經費。
手機鬧鐘的音量及音樂聲，都可按照個人的使用習慣來調整。

items.wordHook: Executing duties 按(based on) rules that 照(shine) light on standard procedure: 按照 means according to.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 這面牆壁上的圖畫真美，是誰畫的？
這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
為了旅客搭機安全，機場入境、出境時都要檢查行李。
有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。

items.wordHook: 便(convenient) + 宜(suitable) → a price convenient and suitable for your wallet: cheap.
Combining 再(again) and 說(speak): 再說 means moreover, furthermore.
A handy item for 凳(bench) with suffix 子(child): 凳子 means stool.
Combining 單(single) and 身(body): 單身 means single.
Combining 季(a quarter-year) and 節(festival): 季節 means season.
Trained to 攝(absorb) light and capture moving 影(shadow) pictures through an optical 機(machine): 攝影機 means video camera.
The 斬(chop) cuts the 日(sun) short, so its light is only 暫(temporary).
Soothing 氵(water) poured into a warm ceramic 皿(dish) warms cold hands until they feel delightfully 溫(warm).
Combining 畢(finish) and 竟(finally): 畢竟 means after all.
Spreading warm 衤(cloth) over delicate 皮(skin) at night provides cozy 被(bedding).
A 身-shaped figure bends at the waist to lift a heavy sack → 身(body).
an 殹(an echo) rings through the 酉(wine) cellar as the healer works to 醫(cure).
